True pigmentary “black” varies by lighting and genetics, but the term “black spots” in common and scientific contexts refers to these characteristic dark patches. No separate color-filter coefficient is applied, as the dark patches are functionally and visually classified as such in ecological literature.

This figure represents the best single-point estimate given current global population surveys and subspecies-specific spot density data.
